name: Haaga Helia University of Applied Sciences
overview:
Haaga-Helia is a boldly business orientated university of applied sciences in Finland. Through education, research and development, they prepare professionals for business and services. They focus on co-operation, entrepreneurship, innovation and internationality.


At Haaga-Helia you will become a member of a student community of over 11 000 members! You can study to become an expert in business, tourism, hospitality and event management, journalism, information technology, or sports management. Our practical studies give you the skills to work independently in various professional tasks and in

international environments.
administrative:
1) Application Dossier


  • Once the IAFF office has sent your nomination, the partner university will contact you directly by email to start your application.
  • All required documents will have to be uploaded on their platform or sent by email before the deadline.
  • (See EMEA Teams channel for each application deadline.)
If you have not received anything yet, it means your nomination has not been sent yet – please be patient.


To be completed with your Epitech bachelor campus administration during the registration period for Tech4 (usually in April/May):

  • The addendum to the contract
  • EPITECH re-registration dossier


2) Visa


  • For European students:
  • A valid passport or national ID card is sufficient to travel within Europe (exception: the UK).
  • For non-European students or students with non-European citizenship:
  • Please check the immigration office of the host country for the visa process and fees.


More information provided by Haaga Helia here.
Students in France can also visit: https://www.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fr/


3) Insurance


For European students:


  • The European Health Insurance Card (CEAM) is nominative and individual.
  • This card certifies your rights to Health Insurance in Europe.
  • To obtain your card:
  • Log in to your Ameli account at least two months before your departure
  • It is free of charge and will be sent to your place within two weeks
  • You can also download it online
More info: https://www.ameli.fr/assure/droits-demarches/europe-international/protection-sociale-etranger/etudes-etranger


For non-European students:


  • You must register for a private health insurance to cover your full stay.
  • Please check with your parents, bank, or any private insurance company for more details, depending on your desired coverage.


Important for French citizens:


Please register via the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Ariane) platform to stay informed about emergencies (e.g., terrorist attack, tsunami, earthquake) in your host country: https://pastel.diplomatie.gouv.fr/fildariane/dyn/public/login.html
